steps.content: The Apostle of Ashes Sun Crow has been vanquished, and the Eastian delegation has embarked on their return journey after a brief rest at the MBCC. All of this seems to signify a break from the recent hustle. You're finally able to catch a breath.
However, the illusion is shattered by the stacks of pending reports lying on your desk.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Two days ago, we received a warning from Sinner Yanyan about the aging circuits in the Bureau. She predicted a short circuit last night that would cause a series of explosions with severe consequences.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Logistics took this message seriously. They've organized an emergency inspection and scheduled staff to be on watch. But as of 7 a.m. today, there was no malfunction in the circuits.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Because of that prophecy about some bad guys who would soon break into the Bureau and destroy valuable data, we've been on heightened security for a week straight, with each team member taking on three additional night shifts.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: But the biggest crisis that occurred this week was just a group of drunks lingering at the entrance yesterday, who we took to the Public Security Bureau. Chief, please advise if we should maintain the current security level?
You close the reports from Logistics and Security and quickly glance through the rest of the documents, whose content is more or less the same.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: In other words... Yanyan has been making prophecies with severe consequences, but they've all ended up being false alarms that put everyone on edge for nothing?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Yes. Serial explosion, break-in, data breach, widespread power outage... These are all potential A-level accidents that could cause massive losses.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Following your instructions, we took every prophecy by Sinner Yanyan seriously and invested substantial resources and manpower into preventing the crises she predicted.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The result is as you can see. The heads of various departments have all expressed their pressing inclination to lower the priority of the prophecies. Personally, I also have reservations about their accuracy.
You get what Nightingale is saying. After all, her job requires her to focus on outcomes, and it's been a long time since Yanyan's prophecies have produced convincing results.
Trust wears off. While you can force the Bureau to continue responding to Yanyan's prophecies, it's not beneficial for either Yanyan or the Bureau.
Moreover, you also harbor concerns about the changes in Yanyan's prophetic abilities.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Remove Yanyan's prophecies from the crisis response list for now. The departments can resume their normal operations.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And... Give Yanyan a heads-up. Tell her I would like to have a chat.
As soon as you enter the interrogation room, you notice Yanyan's restlessness. Her slender arms are propped on the seat and her body is swaying back and forth in an agitated way.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yanyan, I think you've guessed why I'm here. Recently, your prophecies...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Ah, yes. You must have come to learn more about my latest prophecy, right? Our minds are always so in sync!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Your latest prophecy? No, actually, I...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: One second. Yanyan needs to recall the specifics... Every detail in a prophecy counts!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Especially one that clearly involves a power so evil, so scary, so dangerous! Like this one!
Despite her need to recall the details, Yanyan doesn't stop talking and immediately launches into an endless explanation, as if speaking faster could keep whatever she fears from catching up.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Last night, I did as Grandma said and went to bed early. But as soon as I closed my eyes, I felt the ceiling open up into a path!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I'd never seen this path before. The floor and the walls were filthy. I tried to see what was at the end of it, but I ended up glimpsing a huge, living shadow!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: "Shadows looming, demons lurking." I even blurted out this sentence in my dream! Then the path disappeared, and I woke up!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: To figure out what this prophecy meant, I looked through Grandma's notebook all night...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Does Grandma's notebook contain records of events happening in DisCity?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Eh, I mean, everything in the world is interconnected! Ah, but that's not important. Just let me finish!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Anyway, I found some folklore in the notebook that seemed relevant! Of course, they were all just bits and pieces, but I pieced them together.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: The legend says that in an alley so deep that even sunlight can't reach, darkness and filth will gather and give rise to evil! It will swallow everyone's kindness, turn it into its own strength, and harm everyone in return.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: So I've come to a conclusion! At the end of that path, there must be a very terrifying evil spirit! It's going to harm everyone. Chief, we must act quickly to eliminate it!
In stark contrast to Yanyan's fervent words, your reaction is exceedingly calm.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But let's forget about this prophecy for now. I need to ask you about something else.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: W-what can be more important than this prophecy?!
Despite her righteous tone, Yanyan's fingers gripping the edge of the interrogation chair and her darting eyes inadvertently reveal her discomfort and avoidance.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's in fact quite important. After all, the delegation has been gone for a while now, but you're still here.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What I want to know is, why didn't you go back with them? Is there something in DisCity that requires the attention of a seer?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Um, um... Because DisCity is too much fun...? No, no, that makes Yanyan seem too playful...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Oh, I know! It's because Yanyan wants to fully understand what the world outside Eastia is like. I must bring back stories for the folks back home! That's my responsibility as a seer!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I need to stay here and research more in order to do that, that's why I must stay in DisCity! Yes, that's it!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Alright, I believe you. But have you thought about when you might go back?
Clearly, Yanyan feels uncomfortable at your barrage of questions. She seems to be hiding something. She's fidgeting with her fingers and avoiding eye contact, shifting restlessly in her seat.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Why must you keep asking about this? I just said I'm staying here to understand DisCity more!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Once Yanyan has spent enough time here and learned what needs to be learned, I will definitely go back!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Ugh, s-stop looking at me like that. That prophecy Yanyan just told you about is really urgent! It's an emergency! You can't afford to waste one more second!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Chief, we need to set off on an investigation immediately! If something happens, it'll be too late!
Appealing urgently, the girl looks at you with wide eyes and an expression full of genuine worry and unease.

You know she isn't the type to lie to get away from unfavorable situations, but you also know that while Yanyan isn't a liar, her knowledge and abilities might not yet be sufficient to discern the validity of the message.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yanyan, are you really sure?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Yes! Yanyan can't just ignore this evil spirit. What if it hurts someone passing by...
You sigh and put the reports on the table.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I mean, are you sure your prophecy is accurate?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I don't doubt your determination to protect the people. But as far as I know, most of your recent prophecies didn't come true.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Are you having issues with your power?
Hearing your words, a momentary panic flashes across Yanyan's face, but she quickly manages to calm down.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Yanyan's prophecies are derived from divine oracles. Maybe, maybe I made some mistakes in the interpretation... That's why they turned out this way...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: If an adult can help correct it, my prophecies will be accurate! Nothing's wrong with Yanyan's power! ...That should be the case, right?
Seeing Yanyan trying to convince herself, you suddenly don't have the heart to point out the issue anymore. But you also know that it won't do anyone any good.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But... Before this, your prophecies have never deviated so much from reality. Am I right?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The serial explosion you predicted never happened. The aging circuits were just replaced three weeks ago. The potential intruders were just some passing drunks and stray cats. The costly new backup power system hasn't even been used...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yanyan, you're a smart kid. I don't need to go on further, do I?
With the facts laid out openly, Yanyan stammers for a while but still can't utter a word of rebuttal, her eyes threatening to grow teary.
The girl's pitiful look makes you soften your tone.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This is why I called you here today. Yanyan, I hope you can tell me immediately whenever you encounter any problems. We can face them and solve them together.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Simply burying your head in the sand won't make the lion chasing you go away. Yanyan, you've learned this lesson from your grandma's stories, right?
Your words make Yanyan's head hang low like a drooping little sunflower weighed down by frost.
After a long while, you finally hear her voice as soft as a mosquito's buzz.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: You're right, ${PlayerName}. I'm indeed having some issues with my power...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: After the Sun Crow was defeated, Yanyan's prophecies started becoming inaccurate...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: At first, it was just that no one believed me and everyone just laughed at Yanyan's myths. At that time, I thought it didn't matter as long as I believed in them.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: But later, even though Yanyan made the bow according to the myth, the Sun Shot still failed... Being able to see the Great Seer was not a useful skill, and I even got you injured...
If that's the case... you might have already figured out the connection.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I understand now. Yanyan, your abilities originated in faith, but the events that occurred after your arrival in DisCity have dealt a blow to your belief.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Slowly, you began to doubt whether your abilities were of any use, and this doubt, in turn, affected the stability of your power.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Exactly! I feel both so scared and anxious. I want to make some useful prophecies to prove my abilities are still useful, but, but...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But the harder you try, the more inaccurate they become, to the point where even other Sinners start joking about it.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The more they joke about it, the stronger your frustration and the more inaccurate your prophecies become. It's a vicious cycle... That's also why you've been dragging your feet about going home, right?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Hmm...
Yanyan hangs her head, her voice filled with unexpressed grievances and self-reproach.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: My abilities, compared to those of the Great Seer and Du Ruo, are far too lacking... With my power, I can't fulfill everyone's wish or protect the folks of Sunsink City from disasters...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: And now even my basic divination skill has gone haywire... How can I become a worthy seer like this...

You can't believe the honest and cheerful girl has become so anxious that she's delaying her trip back home. Her situation has worsened to this extent partly because of your negligence after the battle with the Sun Crow.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm sorry I haven't been taking good care of you. I only realized your difficulties now.

steps.speaker: Cherish your life, my dear. Don't you have someone you're waiting for? Don't you miss her?
steps.content: It's not ${PlayerName}'s fault... It's all because Yanyan isn't strong enough, that's why...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't think like that, Yanyan. It was your compass and myth that led us to find the materials for the bow, and it was your perseverance that helped us seize the final moment to defeat the Sun Crow.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You are not weak. You will definitely become a worthy seer.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: You're just being nice to Yanyan. I know I've been causing trouble all along and haven't been much help...
Your attempt to console her seems futile. The confidence she's lost obviously won't be easily restored with just a few words.
Perhaps, you need to convince her with facts.

options: Invite her on a field investigation

choices.text: Invite her on a field investigation

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Listen, Yanyan. You said you can't protect everyone or fulfill their wishes, so you can't be a worthy seer, right?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Then let's try it out and see if you can protect people and grant their wishes.
Yanyan immediately lifts her head, her eyes wide with surprise as she looks at you.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Can I...? Can Yanyan have another chance?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Of course. Besides, a crisis happens to be awaiting us now, remember?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Let's start with that legendary evil spirit at the end of the alley you prophesied about just now.
